apihelp-wtmarticles-summary: List articles available in the Wikipedia Time Machine and their covered time windows.
apihelp-wtmsnapshot-summary: Resolve the article revision that was current at a UTC time (via the system-versioned projection).
apihelp-wtmsnapshot-param-wiki: Source wiki ID (default: the configured wiki, e.g. enwiki).
apihelp-wtmcompare-param-wiki: Source wiki ID (default: the configured wiki).
apihelp-wtmask-param-wiki: Source wiki ID (default: the configured wiki).
apihelp-wtmsnapshot-param-at: UTC time (ISO 8601). A date without a time means the end of that day.
apihelp-wtmcompare-summary: Resolve two UTC times and return both snapshots and a deterministic text diff.
apihelp-wtmcompare-param-after: Second UTC time (ISO 8601); must not be before the first.
apihelp-wtmask-summary: Answer a question about two historical revisions with cited, side-specific evidence.
apihelp-wtmclaims-summary: Bitemporal officeholder claims: as of each Wikipedia time, who did the article say held the office on a date.
apihelp-wtmclaims-param-validat: Date the office was held (application time), YYYY-MM-DD.
